title: You have very good genetics, Trump tells Marcos
summary: United States President Donald Trump praised President Marcos’ “very good genetics” and called his son, House Majority Leader Sandro Marcos, “a beautiful young man.”

blocks.text: Screengrab shows former first lady Imelda Marcos speaking with US President Donald Trump during his visit to Malacañang on November 18, 2026.
MANILA, Philippines — United States President Donald Trump praised President Marcos’ “very good genetics” and called his son, House Majority Leader Sandro Marcos, “a beautiful young man.”
In his speech during the Association of Southeast Asian Nations-US Special Summit Tuesday night, Trump thanked Marcos for “a beautiful welcome” as he returned to the country.

“I just don’t want to date myself, but I knew your parents very well and they were great. I believe in genetics and they did a good job. You have very good genetics, I can tell you that,” the US leader said.

“Your family is amazing. You’re amazing. And I just met your son. He’s a beautiful young man. He’s got a great future. And it’s an honor to meet you, especially to meet you, OK? You’ve done a good job. Your parents have done a very good job. So, it’s a great honor,” he added.
The Ilocos Norte representative was among the officials who welcomed Trump during his arrival in Manila Tuesday afternoon. Trump was seen talking to Sandro at the airport.

A social media post yesterday also showed Trump exchanging pleasantries with Marcos’ mother, former first lady Imelda Marcos, before his departure for Shenzhen, China for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Summit.
“We love you,” Trump told Marcos as she greeted him.
During their bilateral meeting at Malacañang yesterday, Marcos revealed having asked his staff on Tuesday to deliver food from Jollibee to Trump and his delegation “as a late night snack.”
“However, since you’re strapped for time, I thought the taste of Manila might be, might be good,” Marcos said.

“I think they gave you the… Jollibee is a very, very popular chain. And one of their main products is fried chicken, and we are very proud to say that we have surpassed KFC in the United States in terms of popularity,” Marcos said, to which the US leader responded, “Oh, wow. Fantastic.”

Trump also praised Marcos’ “excellent leadership” as chair of the ASEAN this year. Trump told ASEAN leaders the US is “deeply committed to the success, sovereignty and prosperity of our many friends and partners.”

Also during the ASEAN-US Summit, Trump promised to be always accessible to Southeast Asian leaders and joked that he would immediately fire Secretary of State Marco Rubio if he failed to respond quickly to their concerns.
He reiterated his support for allies in what he called “one of the world’s most vibrant and productive regions.”
He also called ASEAN countries “great friends” of the US.
In his speech, Trump said Washington is “deeply committed” to the success, sovereignty and prosperity of its friends and partners. “We’re with you always,” he said.

“We support our partners and our allies 100 percent. And when there’s a problem, you call me. You’ll call (US State Secretary) Marco (Rubio). You’ll call others. And if they don’t respond, call me. I’ll take your call. I’ll say, ‘Marco, you’re fired. You didn’t, you didn’t respond fast enough,’” he added.
